scientific_integrity: The universal statement is proved directly from the adjacency structure. Exhaustive computation through order 11 is used only as a stress test. The initiating primary paper was inspected in full-text HTML and targeted literature/index searches found no covering complete-multipartite statement; terminology drift remains a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete multipartite graphs with at least two parts; deleting cross-part edges destroys the one-part description of independent sets and is not covered.
title: Odd independent sets in complete multipartite graphs
